scenes.text: This tutorial covers Plate Viewer. Explore any measurement as a plate heatmap and identify spatial artifacts or edge effects.
Open Plate Viewer from the Results and quality control section. Open a measurements database with plate, well, and condition identifiers.
In the main configuration area, choose the measurement, aggregation, normalization, color scale, controls, and plate layout.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. compare raw and normalized views and inspect suspicious wells or systematic edge patterns.
When the workflow finishes, heatmaps, selected-well tables, and edge-effect diagnostics can be exported.
